deletedLead: Deleted problems are hidden everywhere. They can be restored during the grace period; after it the heavy data is purged and submissions stay.
restored: {code} was restored. It is visible again.
purgeBody: Test data, statements, translations and comments are removed for good. Submissions and contest history stay. This cannot be undone.
purgeQueued: {code} is queued for purging. The server handles it in a few minutes.
typeCode: Type the problem code {code} to confirm

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.lead: Deleting hides the problem everywhere at once. Its code stays reserved.
danger.body: It can be restored during the grace period (30 days by default) under “Deleted”. A problem that is in a contest cannot be deleted.
danger.dialogBody: The problem disappears from lists, its page and search. Everyone’s submissions stay.
